steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is not blocked by the tenant setting.
Keep the project configured with its Auction stage.
Confirm the Auction stage has a template applied.
Add the single required line item.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet for the line item.
Set and save the event duration to 240 minutes, equivalent to 4 hours.
Add the two available QA test vendors without inventing company names.
Publish the configured eRFX Auction event.
Confirm publishing reached a real project page.
Confirm the published Project Details screen exposes the bidding end field required by the case.
